annotations.title: Pass an idea to the Taseli team

description: Sends the Taseli team a note about something the owner asked for that Taseli can't do yet (a change with no tool, a missing report, a platform feature), or an improvement the conversation showed. It changes nothing in the account.

idea.description: In one or two English sentences: what was wanted, in concrete terms (platform, setting, what for).

kind.description: missing_capability: Taseli can't do what was asked. improvement: it can, but it should be easier or better.

quote.description: The owner's own words, when they asked for it.

name: record_idea

note.description: A plain note instead of data (nothing connected yet, not available here).
